Applies prompt and response guardrails, content-safety policies, data protection, and responsible AI controls. Establishes monitoring and alerting for requests, tokens, latency, errors, model usage, costs, and policy enforcement. Experience integrating generative AI models, agents, and services through standardized gateway interfaces and reusable patterns. Proficiency with infrastructure as code, declarative configuration, automated testing, and deployment pipelines. Conduct engineering configuration management of hardware, software and system artefacts across fixed and deployable production domains. Conduct technical integration testing before configuration updates or releases. Support innovation proposals and integration of additional systems, including Army battle-management systems, mission applications and partner-network capabilities. Strong understanding of LAN and WAN engineering, including IP addressing, routing, DNS, DHCP and network segmentation. Ability to operate as a senior technical practitioner and provide authoritative engineering advice without oversight. Ability to work in person at the primary facility. Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, federation mechanisms and PKI. Scripting/automation/software development using technologies such as PowerShell, Bash or Ansible. Windows 11 and Windows Server 2022+ SOE design, configuration and management. System-of-systems engineering experience. System architecture and Interface Control Documentation experience. Technical integration testing, risk-reduction, acceptance-testing or trials experience. Software development or systems integration involving applications including XMPP Chat, mail relay and proxy services. Mobile Device Management, End User Device configuration and application/binary whitelisting experience. Desirable Experience Configuration management across complex hardware and software systems. Deployable, Joint or Coalition ICT/mission systems. Technical reports and engineering assessments for senior decision-makers. Defence capability development, integration, Test & Evaluation or experimentation environments. Understanding of FVEY networks, systems and processes.
